nvitk.measure.morphometrics_config¶

Algorithm constants for TOF Circle-of-Willis morphometrics.

These are processing defaults ported from cow_morpho. Paths (segmentation input, output directory, vessel topology) are resolved by the qvtpy stage-7 driver (nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.stage7_morphometrics) via nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.eicab.morpho_paths and nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.config layout constants — not here.

Classes¶

MorphometricsConfig

Runtime configuration for TOF morphometrics (defaults mirror module constants).
